title: Concept: Windows ini file content served in a response
description: win.ini is the Windows counterpart of the Unix password database for proving a traversal: it sits in the system directory, has no application purpose, and its marker line cannot appear in a response that stayed inside the web root.
applicability: Responses served by a Windows-hosted web server, framework or API that maps a client-controlled path to the filesystem.
risk: The caller has read a file outside the web root on a Windows host, which usually extends to configuration and credential files in the same directory.
